verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents data-retention and model-training opt-outs, and states self-hosted Enterprise customers can 'opt out of all data retention at any time,' with model output logging as a separate controllable setting — but this is scoped to code/review data retention rather than a general telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out, and the full opt-out is Enterprise/self-hosted only, not available to standard cloud users. missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out toggle for cloud/non-enterprise accounts, independent confirmation that opting out actually stops usage tracking.
